Name: Abhishek Dureja
Bio:
Prof Abhishek Dureja is an Assistant Professor of Economics at Plaksha University. His primary research areas include Health Economics, Development Economics, and Risk and Insurance. He combines secondary data with quasi-experimental methods to understand causal relationships and contribute to evidence-based policymaking.

Prior to joining Plaksha University, Prof Dureja was a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Centre for Management of Health Services at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad. For more details about his research and other activities, please visit his webpage.
Education: PhD, Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research, Mumbai
Research_Interests: Maternal and Child Health | Impact Assessment | Risk and Insurance | Food, Health, and Nutrition | Applied Econometrics | Health Economics | Development Economics
